basis: Expected rows are pinned to the documented SQL:2003 T612 aggregate FILTER and ordered-set aggregate semantics linked below; external engines are not executed by this fixture test. DataFusion 54 supports FILTER and ordered STRING_AGG but not PERCENTILE_DISC WITHIN GROUP; the percentile rows are pinned to PostgreSQL 16 / DuckDB 1.5.5.
setup: CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, g TEXT, v INTEGER, name TEXT); INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 'a', 5, 'x'), (2, 'a', 20, 'y'), (3, 'a', NULL, 'z'), (4, 'b', 30, 'w'), (5, 'b', NULL, NULL), (6, 'b', 20, 'y')

cases.name: filter_counts_and_null_predicates
cases.sql: SELECT g, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v > 10) AS big, COUNT(*) AS total FROM t GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

cases.name: filter_empty_set_scalar_results
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(v) FILTER (WHERE FALSE), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE FALSE) FROM t

cases.name: filter_before_distinct
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v) FILTER (WHERE g = 'a'), COUNT(DISTINCT v) FROM t

cases.name: ordered_string_agg_with_tie_break
cases.sql: SELECT g, STRING_AGG(name, ',' ORDER BY v DESC, name ASC) FROM t GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

cases.name: percentile_disc_discrete_selection
cases.sql: SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v), PERCENTILE_DISC(0) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v), PERCENTILE_DISC(1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FROM t

cases.name: percentile_disc_per_group_with_filter
cases.sql: SELECT g, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FILTER (WHERE v < 30) FROM t GROUP BY g ORDER BY g
